title: MURAL _ Paint spray gun
description: Aerosol cans are widely used today, from creating murals and artistic pieces to home repairs, furniture restoration, school projects, and everyday maintenance tasks. In most of these cases, a different can is needed for each color or finish, which leads to high levels of consumption.

This issue doesn’t just affect muralists or street artists, it impacts anyone working on small DIY projects or creative hobbies. The environmental and economic consequences of aerosol use are significant, highlighting the urgent need for more sustainable and efficient alternatives.

A portable electric paint gun is being designed, featuring an interchangeable, refillable, and easy-to-clean paint container. This container is transparent, allowing users to see the remaining amount of paint and its color. The gun is similar in size to a standard aerosol can, making it easy to handle. It is activated via a front-facing trigger button operated with the index finger, ensuring optimal ergonomics for both right- and left-handed users. Additionally, it includes a rechargeable battery and a motor with four adjustable power levels, providing precise control over paint flow and adaptability to different types of applications.

This design responds to the environmental and technical limitations of traditional aerosol cans. Conventional cans are neither refillable nor reusable, leading to excessive waste and increased user costs. In areas such as mural art, furniture repair, or home projects, multiple cans are often needed—raising environmental impact and limiting the user’s ability to adapt their workflow. This design offers a more efficient and sustainable solution by introducing a reusable system that reduces waste and optimizes paint usage.

The goal of this design is to provide a more economical and eco-friendly alternative to disposable aerosol cans. Over time, users can significantly reduce costs by avoiding the repeated purchase of new cans. Since the system is refillable and interchangeable, users have the freedom to work with any type of paint, brand, or base (including water-based paints), allowing better adaptation to the specific needs of each project. The adjustable paint flow, combined with the ergonomic design of the gun, offers greater control, improving precision and comfort during extended or detailed tasks
